opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt or excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or a Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, or local authorities.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines for submission. Decisions typically within 4-6 months. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital and project grants tend to be 10-20% of total costs (local community capital projects capped at £30,000).

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (regardless of the organisation's annual income). Must be an eligible UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest all year round with no deadlines; Expressions of Interest are reviewed on a rolling basis and successful applicants are invited to submit a full proposal.
